voice.name: Open Sector - Battle Ship
voice.description: Older male fleet admiral in his late fifties, booming, grand and theatrical voice with rich deep resonance, a pompous upper-class naval accent, speaks as if every order were a line from a stage play, proud, bombastic and utterly confident in his enormous guns.
voice.sample: Gentlemen, behold! Fifty thousand tons of steel and splendour, and every one of them pointed at the enemy. Bring the forward turrets about. Let history record that we were magnificent!

ready: The battleship is launched! Prepare for greatness.
die: [shouting] I shall go down with her!

fire.prompt: Colossal broadside of a modern battleship firing its 16-inch guns at sea, a deafening thunder-clap of three huge cannons with a long rolling echo over the water.

move.prompt: Huge warship horn blast followed by deep rumbling steam turbine engines and bow wake churning, close, no music, no voice

die.prompt: Massive battleship magazine explosion, huge fireball blast, tearing steel and secondary explosions, hull groaning as it sinks into the sea with hissing steam, no music, no voice
